limitations: Ten exposed acquisition misses, 24 frozen synthetic constructions and four separate exact repeats. Labels and descriptions do not guide discovery; not a representative external benchmark.

Flat tries the prior reduced bucket method at depth zero. Tree and memo use two extra conditioning levels with the same width-eight and 262144 per-node probe caps. Only memo shares exact normalized residual plus remaining depth within each root.

Every node first tries complete semantic buckets; unresolved nodes split on the most frequent variable with name tie breaking. Both children are explored even if one already proves SAT. This supports exact partition comparison but can do avoidable work.

At depth d, at most 2^(d+1)-1 bucket calls occur without reuse. Each has its own table-probe allowance; the budget does not bound normalization, planning, pivot choice, verification, time or RAM. Unknown branches never imply UNSAT.

SAT cofactors lift using the inverse order-preserving normalization map and the fixed branch bit; UNSAT needs both exact cofactors. Every leaf program and edge is checked. Full boundary bucket witness choices remain present.

All workers start empty, use the same fallback, reuse exact root programs within a stream, replay all proofs warm and twice cold, and compress JSON/SQLite archives. No operator cache is added. The root-local DAG is encoded inside a separate experimental JSON authority.

Two existing native readers validate fallback records; both additional cold passes use the same conditioned/bucket checker, not two independent JSON checker implementations. Native, affine, equivalence and Lean formats remain unchanged.

Complete timing includes preparation, acquisition, checking, JSON/SQLite persistence, warm replay, cold replay and compression. Interpreter startup, report metadata, panel generation, historical storage and lineage audit are additional.
Conditioning can require exponentially many distinct residuals and table width can remain high. No production default, unrestricted compactness guarantee or polynomial SAT claim is changed.
